description: LLM configuration for Stage 2 only (intake/SPEC.md section 6). The model, thresholds and per-turn call budget are config, never constants in code. Question selection, applicability, coverage maths and status transitions are deterministic and never involve a model.
model_note: Set INTAKE_LLM_MODEL to override per environment. The provider sits behind a port (intake/backend/adapters/llm.py); swapping it is one new adapter, not a rewrite.
adapter_note: 'disabled' is the default so no build, test or smoke run can make a paid call by accident. Set INTAKE_LLM_ADAPTER=openai (with OPENAI_API_KEY set) to enable it.
max_calls_note: SPEC section 6: at most two calls per turn - one to parse the answer, one to rephrase an explainer if the canned one failed.

confidence.threshold_note: At or above this, the parse is played back to the client for confirmation. Below it, we ask one clarifying question; a second low-confidence attempt escalates to a human. Mirrors the data-driven threshold approach already used by backend/app/services/classification_service.py.

notes: The model proposes a parse; the application writes the state after the client confirms it.
A parse is never accepted silently - the client always sees what was understood first.
Free-text values whose vocabulary is still provisional are passed through as written, not normalised into invented options.
